title: Observability corridor digest - tracing & cost telemetry (2028-07-10)
body:
Purpose: quick corridor-style handoff for the week — lightweight capture of traces, dashboard changes, cost telemetry anomalies and immediate actions. Intended for SRE/observability engineers and platform owners.

TL;DR:
- Sampling experiment (multi-tier) reduced daily span volume ~28% without losing top-100 latency signals. (see JIRA-OBS-984)
- New dashboard layout for tenant-level token-cost now live in staging; feedback loop opened (Zara).
- Two cost spikes identified on 2028-07-07 between 03:20–04:05 UTC; root cause: high-retry storm on embedding service due to transient DB error. Mitigation: temporary rate limiter and retry-jitter change rolled out.

Meeting notes (2028-07-10 standup capture):
- Priya: Quick recap of sampling experiment A/B. Ethan's script picks high-cardinality endpoints and applies 1% tail-preserving sampling for spans >500ms. Early results: error-rate visibility unchanged for top-50 endpoints; noise down on low-value background jobs. Need longer run to judge regressions on unusual edge cases.
- Ethan: Dashboard changes pushed to staging: tenant-cost-by-route, token-burn heatmap, and a new cheap-call-detection tile. Screenshots in the PR. UX comment: heatmap defaults to a 90-day window, which is heavy; switch to 14-day default.
- Zara: Cost telemetry alerted on two large token usage bursts tied to embedding fallback logic. Correlated logs show burst began after connection timeouts to cache layer. Working hypothesis: cache reconnect jitter collapsed and retries aligned.
- Liam: Tracing ingestion lag remains ~6s at peak; infra team traced to backpressure on kafkajs consumer during big backfills. Proposed mitigations: increase consumer parallelism + change partition assignment to avoid hot partitions.

Key decisions and rationale:
1) Adopt multi-tier sampling (low, mid, tail-preserve) as experimental default for non-prod and a 2-week ramp in prod if no regressions seen. Rationale: good drop in cost with minimal signal loss in early metrics. Owner: Priya. JIRA: JIRA-OBS-984.
2) Short-term: set dashboard heatmap default to 14d in staging to avoid redundant large queries; long-term: add async thumbnail generation for heavy tiles. Owner: Ethan.
3) Retry storm mitigation: add randomized exponential jitter to embedding service cache reconnect + temporary global token rate-limit for embedding calls for 12 hours post-detect. Owner: Zara.

Action items (owner - ETA):
- Priya: run 14-day experiment with multi-tier sampling on 3 traffic slices (canary, beta, prod-small) and collect top-100 endpoint regressions. ETA: 2028-07-17.
- Ethan: update staging dashboard defaults and add a small banner explaining window selection; move heavy tiles to async. ETA: 2028-07-13.
- Zara: finish correlation playbook for cache-timeout->embed-fallback, draft runbook entry and add to linked confluence page. ETA: 2028-07-12.
- Liam: proposal for increasing consumer parallelism + partition rebalancing (impact analysis). ETA: 2028-07-15.
- Ops: investigate 2028-07-07 cost spike billing metadata and tag affected customers for credits review. ETA: 2028-07-14.

Experiments and instrumentation notes:
- Sampling experiment details: script applies deterministic hash-based sampling on trace_id with three buckets: 0.5% full, 5% mid (preserve tail by latency hooks), 94.5% low (span-level partial). Instrumentation change is a runtime flag with safe fallback to previous sampling if tracer errors.
- New telemetry tag: route_cost_bucket (cheap|moderate|expensive) — being added to spans and logs to make cross-correlation quick. Remember to update GDPR/K-anon mapping for tenant tagging.
- Dashboard telemetry: add synthetic load tests for dashboard queries during CI to catch outage/latency before merge. Ethan to add to observability CI.

Anomalies (raw):
- 2028-07-07 03:22–03:44 UTC: embedding calls 3x normal QPS, 18% p99 latency increase, retries x6. Cache reconnect logs show repeated 503s to memcache cluster node A.
- 2028-07-08 11:05 UTC: sudden trace ingestion backlog due to large audit backfill job; consumer paused for ~90s before auto-rebalance recovered.

Open questions / discussion points:
- How conservative should tail-preserving sampling be across paid tiers? If we preserve too many tails we lose cost benefit; too aggressive and we miss regressions on high-value customers. Suggest we tie tail-preserve ratio to SLA tier for 6-week pilot.
- Dashboard ownership: who will handle ad-hoc dashboard bounces? Currently split across team members; propose rotating dashboard-shift owner (1-week rotation) to triage heavy tiles and queries.
- Long-term: consider moving token-cost aggregation to a pre-aggregated timeseries store (rollups) to avoid expensive on-the-fly joins — design proposal welcome.

Notes-to-self / friction points:
- Need clearer UX for spike annotations on tenant-cost views (who annotated what, permanent vs transient).
- Watch for sampling drift when models change their tokenization behaviour; add tokenization-version tag to spans for a short window after each model rollout.

Useful links / references included above.

Small wins this week:
- 2x reduction in low-priority span volume on staging (Ethan's sampling tweak) -> cheaper dev clusters.
- First pass of tenant-cost-by-route tile shows clear hot routes for a mid-market customer demo; good for GTM story.

If anything urgent emerges ping #observability on Slack and tag Priya.

-- end corridor digest --

Raw edit log (notes to file): 2028-07-10 initial capture; 2028-07-11 minor clarifications and added heatmap default change.
